About.title: Law Shouldn't Be a
About.problemDesc: Every day, legal professionals waste hours verifying citations, chasing amendments, and second-guessing AI hallucinations.
About.solutionDesc: Veritus delivers source-backed answers with zero tolerance for hallucinations—so you can focus on strategy, not fact-checking.
About.closing: Legal integrity you can put your name on.

Features.title: Precision
Features.subtitle: A grounded legal AI stack—retrieval, streaming generation, and jurisdiction-scoped corpora.
Features.sourceBackedDesc: User queries are embedded and matched against a indexed corpus of primary legal authorities. Retrieved passages condition the model via retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), then the answer is token-streamed over SSE so counsel can read as it generates. Citations are bound to the retrieved sources—statutes, case law, regulations—so claims are auditable, not hallucinated free text.
Features.sourceBackedTags: RAG · Vector retrieval · SSE streaming · Citation grounding
Features.documentDesc: Case files are uploaded into a matter-scoped workspace, parsed, and run through a summarization pipeline (including streaming file analysis). Extracted structure and summaries stay attached to the case record, giving the model durable context across pleadings, contracts, and exhibits—so analysis can cross-reference provisions against the live legal corpus, not a single prompt window.
Features.documentTags: Ingestion pipeline · Streaming summarize · Matter context · Multi-doc workspace
Features.jurisdictionDesc: Retrieval is filtered by governing jurisdiction before generation. Federal, state, and regional corpora are partitioned so the ranker prefers authorities from the correct legal system—reducing cross-jurisdictional contamination and keeping answers aligned with the law that actually applies to the matter.
Features.jurisdictionTags: Corpus partitioning · Jurisdiction filters · Authority ranking · Conflict avoidance
